items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Timmy Rosencrantz and the little guy from Vietnam

ctx.x: Baron, yeah. Timmy Rosencrantz and the little guy from Vietnam or whatever his -- Harry Lim, and this whole crowd was gathered and George Simon's apartment. This, by the way, I have a feeling, is why I never got the Jazz Record published through the firm that George Simon is connected with, because I did show him the manuscript and I got a no.

But it was George Simon's apartment, and he wasn't there, Leonard was there. And that's a feeling I have. It may not have any veracity. But he let Leonard have the apartment.
